Resolves #18936

Related: #18792 · #18910 · #18914

🪢 *A text field has had an input sync since #18792. A text area never did: both lookups asked for a node named `input`.*

## What was wrong

`form.field.Text#onInputValueChange` and `#afterVnodeSync` found the real input's vnode with `{nodeName: 'input'}`. `form.field.TextArea` changes that node's tag to `textarea`, so for it neither the keystroke sync nor the landed-render restore ever ran: each keystroke's `update()` diffed the new value against a vnode still holding the old one, and wrote the value back into the DOM.

## The fix

Both lookups go by `getInputElId()` — the id `afterVnodeSync()` already matches deltas by. Two expressions; no `TextArea` override, no new API.

Evidence: L3 (real Chromium, real keys, CI-executed component tier) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-3). Residual: the corruption itself is measured, not armed — it needs a deliberately blocked App Worker and timing; "no programmatic write while typing" is its deterministic form.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the PR baseline jobs run in CI. Change class: bug fix (`fix`).

- `TextArea.spec.mjs` + `Text.spec.mjs`: 21/21 at this head over three repeats. With `dev`'s `Text.mjs` the `TextArea` arm fails on programmatic writes during typing.
